title: Snapback Guide page frontmatter
description: Compatible core shared with the Exact guide (title, id, order, audience, capabilities, authorities, examples, status, reviewed) plus Snapback extensions (targets, maturity, reviewed-commit). Frontmatter uses the flat YAML subset: scalar values and inline arrays only. @ref LLP 0061#design — schema artifact required by the conventions.

id.description: Stable dotted id; reserved as the projection resource id (MCP, console).

capabilities.description: Capability-index ids this page claims coverage of; [] for meta pages.

authorities.description: Repo-root paths (LLPs and code). Freshness compares these against reviewed-commit.

examples.description: Repo-root paths of demos/files exercising what the page teaches.

targets.description: Which execution targets the page's claims hold for; [all] only for genuinely target-independent material.

maturity.description: shipped: teach normally. partial: page must name what works and what does not. design-only: marked design-reference sections only, never a technique.

since.description: Published closure version in which this page's surface first became or is expected to become available.

unreleased.description: The whole page deliberately describes a surface newer than the newest published closure.

reviewed.description: Date of last intentional review — display metadata, never identity.

reviewed-commit.description: Commit the page was last reviewed at — the freshness identity. 'HEAD' permitted only in the change that creates or fully revises the page; the manifest generator resolves it.
